functions.name: SetWorld
functions.docs: In the case that you don't have an owner widget, you should set a world to your pool, or it won't be able to construct widgets.

functions.name: SetDefaultPlayerController
functions.docs:
In the case a pool has no owner widget, a default player controller can optionally be specified allowing greater control
in split screen scenarios. The following priority rules are applied when determining the controller which should own created widgets:
Controller of owning widget (if set) > Default player controller (if set) > First local player controller from world.

functions.name: RebuildWidgets
functions.docs: Triggers RebuildWidget on all currently active UserWidget instances

functions.name: AddReferencedObjects
functions.docs: Report any references to UObjects to the reference collector (only necessary if this is not already a UPROPERTY)

functions.name: Release
functions.docs: Return a widget object to the pool, allowing it to be reused in the future

functions.name: ReleaseAll
functions.docs: Returns all active widget objects to the inactive pool and optionally destroys all cached underlying slate widgets.

functions.name: ResetPool
functions.docs: Full reset of all created widget objects (and any cached underlying slate)

functions.name: ReleaseInactiveSlateResources
functions.docs: Reset of all cached underlying Slate widgets, only for inactive widgets in the pool.

functions.name: ReleaseAllSlateResources
functions.docs: Reset of all cached underlying Slate widgets, but not the active UUserWidget objects
